# Parachute

> Parachute is an open, self-hosted memory that you and any AI can both read and write. A **vault** — a knowledge graph of plain markdown notes — speaks MCP and REST; a **hub** supervises it on a box you own; **surfaces** are custom UIs built over it. You own the box, the data, and the export.

Two doors, one wire contract: run it yourself on your own hardware, or let us
host it. Both speak the same REST/MCP/OAuth endpoints and the same portable
markdown, so moving between them is a copy, not a migration.

If you are an AI agent asked to install Parachute on a machine, read the
install runbook first. It is derived from the CI-proven headless install and it
is the only path that works without a human at a terminal.

## Install

- [Headless install runbook](https://parachute.computer/install.md): imperative, copy-pasteable, non-interactive install of hub + vault on a fresh Ubuntu/Debian box or a Mac. Includes verification commands, known gaps, and troubleshooting. Same page rendered for humans: https://parachute.computer/install/runbook/
- [Self-host, for humans](https://parachute.computer/start/): the narrative version — why self-host, where to run it, what the setup wizard asks.
- [Server one-liner](https://parachute.computer/install/server.sh): the curl-able script the human page recommends for a fresh Ubuntu/Debian box with a public IP. Installs hub + vault + Caddy and gets a real Let's Encrypt certificate. Stops at "open this URL in your browser" — an agent must finish it with `parachute setup-wizard` (see the runbook).

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://parachute.computer/guides/getting-started/): the note that ships inside every fresh vault — the vault-design brief an AI reads to help shape the vault around its owner.
- [Welcome to your vault](https://parachute.computer/guides/welcome-to-your-vault/): what a vault is and what lives in it.
- [Capture anything](https://parachute.computer/guides/capture-anything/): how notes get in.
- [Connect your AI](https://parachute.computer/guides/connect-your-ai/): pointing Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or your own agent at a vault over MCP.
- [Tags and the graph](https://parachute.computer/guides/tags-and-the-graph/): tags are types; how the knowledge graph is shaped.
- [Yours to keep](https://parachute.computer/guides/yours-to-keep/): export, portability, and leaving.

## Building on it

- [Build a surface](https://parachute.computer/surfaces/): a custom browser UI over a vault, using `@openparachute/surface-client` (OAuth + typed vault API) and `@openparachute/surface-render` (note rendering).
- [Script your vault](https://parachute.computer/scripting/): driving the vault REST API from bash, Python, or JS.
- [Multi-user](https://parachute.computer/multi-user/): hosting vaults for other people on one hub.
- [Modules](https://parachute.computer/modules/): what each module in the ecosystem does.

## Endpoints

Every path below is relative to the hub origin — the address the hub answers
on, the same URL a person signs in at. It is *not* the vault's own port (1940);
the vault is reached through the hub.

- MCP: `<hub-origin>/vault/<vault-name>/mcp` — OAuth happens on the first connection. The `/mcp` suffix is required.
- REST notes API: `<hub-origin>/vault/<vault-name>/api/notes` — `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Hub health: `<hub-origin>/health` — 200 with a JSON body carrying `"db":"ok"` when healthy.
- Vault health: `<hub-origin>/vault/<vault-name>/health` — **401 means healthy.** The vault is auth-gated; an unauthenticated probe getting 401 proves it is up and correctly refusing anonymous callers.
- Default ports on the box: hub `1939`, vault `1940`.

## Hosted

- [Parachute Cloud](https://parachute.computer/pricing/): the hosted door. We run the box, you keep the vault, same wire contract.
- [my.parachute.computer](https://my.parachute.computer): the hosted Notes app. It runs in the browser and talks to *any* vault — self-hosted or cloud — so it is also the quickest way to look at a vault you just stood up.

## Source

- [github.com/ParachuteComputer](https://github.com/ParachuteComputer): all modules, open source.
- [parachute-hub](https://github.com/ParachuteComputer/parachute-hub): the hub + the `parachute` CLI (`@openparachute/hub` on npm).
- [parachute-vault](https://github.com/ParachuteComputer/parachute-vault): the vault — knowledge graph, MCP server, REST API (`@openparachute/vault` on npm).
- [parachute-surface](https://github.com/ParachuteComputer/parachute-surface): the UI host and the surface SDK.
- [Blog](https://parachute.computer/blog/): release notes and thinking, in public.
